The '''Battle of Qiilura''' was fought between the colonists on [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]], who harvested [[barq]], and clone troopers led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] along with Commander [[Levet (clone)|Levet]] until Etain started to hemorrhage. The battle was also led by the colonists destroying the [[Gurlanin]]s food supply and refusing to leave when asked. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] provided training and low-grade weapons to the colonists in an effort to receive aid in removing the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] that remained after Etain and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arligan Zey]] rooted out the Separatist network. Due to the request to try and remove the colonists alive, the clone troopers were limited in their abilities. After Etain took leave, Levet took charge of the battle.
